tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg bcas pa bzhugs so// swasti/ rta mgrin bsnyen sgrub bya tshul ni/ bzhi 'bum byed na zla gcig 'bru 'bum byed na zla gsum/ dben pa'i gnas su mar ngo'i nyer gsum lnga dgu gang rung la rang gzhan ji ltar rigs pa'i cha gsum yid ches pa btang / bgegs gtor dor ba'i rjes su sngags yungs gis brab/ sngags gul gyis bdug phyag dar legs par byas la/ 'byor na bla bre dang yol ba bkram/ nub nas shar gzigs sam nang gi bab dang bstun/ rta mgrin gyi sku bris 'bur gang rigs stegs mtho bar bzhugs pa'i drung gos dar ras sogs kyis bkab cing 'bru bkram pa'i gzhi la shing dang bse ma yin pa'i snod ji ltar rigs par phye phud gtsang ma/ bum sman nyer lnga gsar ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rnying ma'i chos sman khrag chang mar chu sogs rdzas gang 'dzoms las sbrus pa'i gtor ma che chung ji ltar rigs pa smad sum gcig zlum po/ stod sum gnyis gru gsum dbal can mtheb kyu lnga bcu bcad kham phyir bstan nas sum cha nub par brtsigs mar rgyan ji ltar rigs pa/ mda' rgod sgro can la bstan pa'i gtor gdugs dmar pos brgyan pa bshams pa'i g.yas g.yon du thod pa tshad ldan dngos sam/ thod gzugs dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang / g.yas su chang dang bdud rtsi ril chos gang rung sbyar ba/ g.yon du khrag la bsil sman btab pa/ mdun du gtor ma'i g.yas nas 'og brtsams chu gnyis me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams gral rim bzhin bshams/ rgyun du yi dam chos skyong gzhan la gtor bsngo byed bzhin pa yin na de dag gi mchod gtor kyang logs shig tu bshams/ thams cad kyang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang ngam/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang dang chu gtsang chang phal pa rnams kyi thig pa gnyis gsum re bran la spos gtsang ma gang rung gis bdug thog ma 'di ma gtogs mtshams ma grol bar gyi thun thams cad la mtheb kyu skam rlon gang rung gi kha gsos nas sbyangs bdug bya/

'byor na mar me yang rgyun du sbar/ zhal zas gsar pa thun re la spo ba'am/ yang na mtheb kyu'i kha gsos/ rten dang mchod gtor la kha phyogs par rang gi mal bshams pa'i 'og tu sa dkar gyi rdo rje rgya gram dang 'bru bkram pa'i khar/ shing dang sa gang rung gi mal khri thog can rlung seng rgyu ba dang / sngas stan sogs ji ltar rigs par bshams pa'i drung lcog tse'i khar ras dar gang rung gi stan la rang gi g.yas nas rim pa bzhin 'thor snod ḍā ma ru rdo rje'i lte ba la dril bu'i tshangs zhal phyogs pa/ chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod snod thod gzugs dpral ba rang la bstan pa rnams bshams/ phreng ba tsan+dan rak+ṣa bo dhi tsit+ta gang rung brgya dang bcu gcig phreng thag grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mos bkal ba'i skud pa dgu bsgril dmar po spod gser byed rgyu bcas/ mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs bcu bshad gsum bzhi gang rung can dang / gzhan yang zas gos/ mtshams g.yog gcig gnyis sman pa rnams sngon ma nas lhus thengs par byas la sgo'i phyi rol ji ltar rigs par sa rdo gang rung las grub pa'i tho dkar dbyibs nges med can nam/ gyang 'debs lta bu la sa dkar sbran kyang chog cing / 'di la byung na rgyal chen bzhi'i bskyed chog gam/ yang na bgegs skrod dang brtan bzhugs tsam gsung mod ma byung kyang 'gal ba med cing / tho rgyab grub bstun rang mi gzhan gyis ye ma mthong zhing rang gi'ang mtshams g.yog sogs nges pa can las gzhan mthong thos dang 'grim 'grul bcad la thun gsum byed na srod thun la 'jug bzhi byed na dgong thun/ mtshams grol ba'i tshe'ang thun gsum ma thor thun dang thun bzhi ma snga thun la grol/ mchod gtor byin rlabs ni/ sbyin sreg na gsal zhing / skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma nas 'di'i bar nyer gcig sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig gzhan sgrub thabs bzhin/ bzlas bya'i sngags/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta krita thun re la brgya stong ji ltar rigs pa dang / thun bsham du/ pad+mān+ta krita la oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥbatags pa gsum/ bzlas pa rdzogs nas/ phreng ba la ha btab spyi bor reg la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ mdun gyi rten la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar paṃ las pad+ma dang zhes pa nas yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin zhes dang / gzhob thul thul sreg pa'i dpral bar oṃ nas sa mā dza'i bar sbyin sreg bzhin dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mā nas hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba ling+taṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bhu dza he rak+ta si pa ta sa mā ya swāhā/

mthar se gol gtog pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rdor dril gsil la/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das sogs bzlas pa'i 'jug bzhin/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig sbyin sreg bzhin/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ dge ba 'di yis sogs sbyin sreg bzhin/ bkra shis ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis bzhi 'bum mam 'bru gsum mthar phyin nas/ sbyin sreg bya tshul yi ge 'di bzhin la 'byor na rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bshams/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams kha gso bcas bshams/ sbyin sreg gi yi ge 'di dbang la gtso bor sbyor bar mdzad 'dug kyang bsnyen pa'i skabs gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa zhi ba dang nus pa byung ba'i phyir sbyin sreg mdzad pas nas/ rang 'jig rten pa'i shar la kha bltas la gos rgyan dkar po byas nas rdzas rnams kyang brgya dang bcu gcig 'bul dgos pas/ yam shing bcu tshan bcu gcig tu bcad/ cho ga byings yig cha 'di bzhin la byon zan phul ba'i rjes su/ ar+ghaṃ nas rak+ta khā ha'i bar/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig rdzas so so'i 'gor rtsa sngags tshar gsum dang rdzas sngags ni/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ yam shing / oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zas mchog oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ so ba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swāhā/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra gasma ri ye swāhā/ gro/

oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ ku sha de thams cad kyi mthar bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes sbyar/ de nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dngos gzhi til la grangs bzung dgos pas g.yon pas phreng ba thogs/ g.yas pas mtheb srin gyi pang par til snod bzhag pa'i til nas snod gcig tu bgrang ba'i tshul bya/ bzhi 'bum dang 'bru 'bum gang song gi bcu cha bzhi khri sogs ma song gi bar la grangs 'dzin dgos pas sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang / zhag grangs gang dgos rtsis la cho ga gong thob bcu tshan bcu la phral gzhan de phyin chad yig cha sor bzhag 'on kyang gtor ma 'bul lugs ni gong bkod bzhin no/ /zhib cha ni lag len shes pa'i rigs la dris brtsad byas pas shin tu gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang bkra shis bde ldan pa phun tshogs stobs rgyas kyi bzhed don du sa skya pa kun blos 'phral mar bris pa yin pas dmigs pa sogs zhib cha ni yig rnying so so las rtogs par bya'o// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
